name: yiban-ui
description: Yiban account console UI. React + Vite + TypeScript on the Adminator 4 design language.

scripts.test:unit: node --import ./scripts/tests/resolve-ts.mjs --test scripts/tests/client.test.mjs scripts/tests/query.test.mjs scripts/tests/cursor.test.mjs scripts/tests/accounts.test.mjs scripts/tests/account-actions.test.mjs scripts/tests/schools.test.mjs scripts/tests/schedule.test.mjs scripts/tests/auth.test.mjs scripts/tests/settings.test.mjs scripts/tests/users.test.mjs scripts/tests/dashboard.test.mjs scripts/tests/test-plan.test.mjs scripts/tests/icon-source.test.mjs scripts/tests/field-aria.test.mjs
scripts.test:e2e:fast: npm run test:behavior && npm run test:shots
scripts.test:behavior: playwright test e2e/accounts.spec.ts e2e/settings.spec.ts e2e/auth.spec.ts e2e/dashboard.spec.ts e2e/gallery.spec.ts e2e/components.spec.ts e2e/schedule.spec.ts e2e/schools.spec.ts e2e/users.spec.ts e2e/microinteraction.spec.ts e2e/showcase.spec.ts --workers=4
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run check:api && npm run test:unit && node scripts/token-gate.mjs --self-test && npm run gate:tokens && node scripts/structure-gate.mjs --self-test && npm run gate:structure && node scripts/doc-ref-gate.mjs --self-test && npm run gate:docs && node scripts/license-gate.mjs --self-test && npm run gate:license && npm run build
